title: A 31-character term prints in full on modern invoices and estimates
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop prints with the modern invoice design, and a customer is on a term with a 31-character name.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization uses the modern invoice design.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds the shop's own term {Term-A}, which has a 31-character name. Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} has an estimate and an invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-13 Long Term Name, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-13 Customer and {Work-order-1} is S2-15440.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the printed estimate of {Work-order-1}.
  2. Open the printed invoice of {Work-order-1}.
  3. Open the work order print of {Work-order-1}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the terms show every character of {Term-A}, without clipping or "...".
  • Step 2: the terms show every character of {Term-A}, without clipping.
  • Step 3: the work order print does not show the credit term at all.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R11: “A term name of up to 31 characters prints in full, without clipping, on modern and legacy invoices and estimates. Work order prints do not show the credit term.”
